scope: Reviewed successful-initialization static registration semantics; no legacy execution or semantic parity
dispatch_rules: dir(self) sorts Python attribute names; duplicate method names retain only the final class definition
baseline functions and data use separate case-sensitive export tables; ordinals alias the same baseline tuple
hook identities are lowercased; exact module/API buckets precede insertion-ordered matching wildcard buckets
supported baseline executes all matching hooks; each original targets the baseline handler; final matched return is retained
unsupported baseline invokes only the final matching hook; original is None; argc/convention come from that hook
ordinal baseline resolution rewrites the hook lookup name to the baseline declared export
A/W generic, CRT/API-set/socket aliases and ntdll-to-kernel fallback follow reviewed normalize_import_miss
run_native queues installs before successful load_module; later module/toolhelp hooks are active only after load
conditional LdrUnloadDll table addition supplies the normal supported-handler dispatch path after load
registration review never promotes literal placeholders, uninstantiated modules, data slots or hook names into behavioral parity
